get.description:
Returns the cart items preserving idMembership, idService and the additionalMemberships array informed
on the cart creation (links between the main membership and its add-ons are kept until checkout).

get.summary: Get cart by idMember or idProspect
get.description:
Besides idCartToken and cartCheckoutLink, returns the cart items in the same structure of
GET /v1/carts/{idCartToken} — including the additionalMemberships informed on the cart creation.

post.description:
The membership item of the cart accepts an optional **additionalMemberships** array with the same
structure of the Sales flow: objects with idMembership and an optional membershipValue. The same link
and eligibility validations of POST v2/sales are applied when the cart is created — an invalid
combination is rejected and does NOT generate a usable cart. FIXED add-ons must not be sent: they are
included automatically when the sale of the main membership is completed at checkout.
            
Example — main membership with multiple optional add-ons:
            
    { "idMember": 123, "items": [ { "idMembership": 100,
      "additionalMemberships": [ { "idMembership": 200 }, { "idMembership": 201, "membershipValue": 45.00 } ] } ] }
            
The add-ons informed on creation are preserved with their links and returned inside the membership
item by GET /v1/carts/{idCartToken} and GET /v1/carts (idMember/idProspect), and follow the cart to
the checkout.

get.summary: List the fitness assessment protocols of a branch
get.description:
Returns the protocols available in the branch for each configurable assessment type: the EVO default
protocol and the custom protocols created by the gym, for Anamnesis (`type` 1), Bioimpedance (`type` 2)
and Circumferences (`type` 3). Skinfolds (`type` 4) has no configurable protocol and never appears here.
            
Protocol ids are unique only within a type. Always use the pair `idProtocol` + `type`:
- to read which fields the protocol enables and requires: `GET /api/v2/fitness-assessment/protocol-detail/{idProtocol}?type={type}`;
- to create a bioimpedance assessment (`POST /api/v2/fitness-assessment/bioimpedance`), which accepts only protocols of `type` 2.

parameters.name: idBranch
parameters.description: Branch id. With a single-branch key this value is ignored and the key's own branch is used; with a multi-location key, it must be one of the branches the key has access to.

401.description: The multi-location key has no access to the requested branch. Body: `{ "mensagens": [ "message" ] }`.

get.summary: Get the field configuration of a protocol
get.description:
Returns the protocol name and, for each field of the assessment, whether it is enabled (`...Enabled`)
and whether it is required (`...Required`) in the EVO APP form.
            
The response body depends on `type`:
- `1` Anamnesis: sections of the questionnaire and the custom questions (`customQuestions`);
- `2` Bioimpedance: body composition and segmental measurements;
- `3` Circumferences: body regions.
            
Protocol ids are unique only within a type, so always send the `type` returned by
`GET /api/v2/fitness-assessment/protocol/{idBranch}`. When `type` is omitted, Bioimpedance (`2`) is assumed.
            
For bioimpedance, a measurement sent in `POST`/`PUT` for a field that is not enabled in the protocol is discarded.
The `...Required` flags describe the EVO APP form: the API itself only enforces `basicData`.
`bodyWaterLitersEnabled` and `bodyWaterPercentageEnabled` tell the unit of `bodyWater`: liters or percentage.
            
`isEvoDefault` is `true` for the EVO default protocol and `false` for a protocol created by the gym.

parameters.name: idProtocol
parameters.description: Protocol id, as returned in `idProtocol` by the protocol list.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Protocol type: `1` Anamnesis, `2` Bioimpedance, `3` Circumferences. Default: `2`. Skinfolds (`4`) has no configurable protocol.

200.description: Protocol configuration. The schema depends on `type`.

400.description: `type` is not 1, 2 or 3 — body `{ "error": "message" }` — or the protocol was not found — body `{ "errors": [ { "key": "Avaliacao", "value": "message" } ] }`.

get.description:
Paginated list of the fitness assessments of all types (Anamnesis, Bioimpedance, Circumferences and Skinfolds),
ordered from the most recent to the oldest. Deleted assessments are not returned.
            
- Single-branch key: returns only the assessments of the key's branch; `idBranch` is ignored.
- Multi-location key: returns the assessments of every branch the key has access to, or only of the branches
  informed in `idBranch`.
            
Each item is a summary. To read the answers of an assessment, use `GET /api/v2/fitness-assessment` with
`idMember`, `idFitnessAssessment` and `idType`.
            
In each item, `type` is `1` Anamnesis, `2` Bioimpedance, `3` Circumferences or `4` Skinfolds (`nameType` has the name);
`idProtocol` is null for Skinfolds, which has no protocol; `editedDate` is null when the assessment was never edited.

parameters.name: idBranch
parameters.description: Multi-location keys only: branch ids to filter. Repeat the parameter for several branches (`idBranch=1&idBranch=2`). Branches the key has no access to are ignored.

parameters.name: expired

get.summary: List a member's fitness assessments or get the answers of one
get.description:
`idMember` is required. The endpoint works in two modes:
            
**List** (without `idFitnessAssessment`): returns a list with a summary of each fitness assessment of the member
in the branch of the key.
            
**Answers** (with `idFitnessAssessment`): returns all the answers of that assessment. Every type returns the same
header (member, employee and `cref`, `dateCreated`, `expiryDate`, `type`, protocol and `basicData`) plus the fields of its type:
- `1` Anamnesis: health history, medications, surgeries, habits, health files and custom questions;
- `2` Bioimpedance: body composition, segmental measurements and photos;
- `3` Circumferences: body regions and photos;
- `4` Skinfolds: calculation method, folds and photos. Skinfolds has no protocol: `idProtocol` and `nameProtocol` are null.
            
Assessment ids are unique only within a type: send `idType` together with `idFitnessAssessment`.
            
**Field values**
- `basicData`: `weight` in kg; `height` in cm; `biologicalSex` `M` (male) or `F` (female) — older records may have
  other values, such as `Feminino` or empty; `morphology` `ectomorfo`,
  `mesomorfo` or `endomorfo` (it may come as the display name, e.g. `Mesomorfo`, so compare ignoring case);
  `objectives` with the objective codes (e.g. `emagrecer`, `saude`, `hipertrofia`, `condicionamento`, `conhecer_pessoas`)
  and `objectivesDescription` with the display name of each one.
- Anamnesis `sleepQuality`: `muito_bom` (very good), `bom` (good), `regular`, `ruim` (poor), `muito_ruim` (very poor).
- Anamnesis `fitnessLevel`: `sedentario` (sedentary), `moderadamente_sedentario` (moderately sedentary),
  `moderadamente_ativo` (moderately active), `ativo` (active).
- Anamnesis `smoker`: `nunca_fumou` (never smoked), `fumante` (smoker), `parou_de_fumar` (quit smoking).
  Smokers fill `cigarettesPerDay` and `yearsSmoking`; former smokers fill `yearsSmoked` and `yearsSinceQuitSmoking`.
- Anamnesis `alcoholIntake`: `nao_bebe` (does not drink), `raramente` (rarely), `ocasionalmente` (occasionally), `diariamente` (daily).
- Anamnesis `professionalActivity` and the `time` of `medications`/`surgeries`: free text.
- Bioimpedance: the same units of the `POST /api/v2/fitness-assessment/bioimpedance` (masses in kg, percentages in %,
  `basalMetabolicRate` in kcal, `metabolicAge` in years). Measurements not enabled in the protocol are null.
- Circumferences: every measurement in cm.
- Skinfolds `skinfoldsProtocol`: `0` Pollock 7 folds, `1` Pollock 3 folds, `2` Faulkner 4 folds, `3` Guedes,
  `4` Guedes (children and adolescents), `5` Guedes (black children and adolescents), `6` Weltman (obese).
  Folds (`triceps`, `subscapular`, `midaxillary`, `chest`, `abdominal`, `suprailiac`, `thigh`) in mm.
- Photos stored by EVO are returned as temporary URLs, valid for 1 hour. Download the images if you need to keep them.

parameters.name: idFitnessAssessment
parameters.description: Id of the assessment to return in full. When omitted, the summary list is returned.

parameters.name: idMember
parameters.description: Member id. Required.

parameters.name: idEmployee

parameters.name: dateCreatedStart
parameters.description: Assessments performed on or after this date (`yyyy-MM-dd`).

parameters.name: dateCreatedEnd
parameters.description: Assessments performed on or before this date (`yyyy-MM-dd`).

parameters.name: idType
parameters.description: Filter by assessment type: `1` Anamnesis, `2` Bioimpedance, `3` Circumferences, `4` Skinfolds. Send it with `idFitnessAssessment`.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: List mode: number of records to return. Default and maximum: 50.

parameters.name: skip
parameters.description: List mode: number of records to skip. Default: 0.

200.description: List mode: summary list (empty when there are none). Answers mode: the answers of the assessment, with the fields of its type.

400.description: `idMember` was not informed — body `{ "error": "message" }` — or `skip`/`take` negative — body `{ "mensagens": [ "message" ] }`.

404.description: Answers mode: the assessment was not found for the member. Body: `{ "error": "message" }`.

post.description:
Creates a bioimpedance assessment (`type` 2) for the member, in the branch of the key, and returns its id.
Use a single-branch key: the creation, the update and the deletion work on the branch of the key.
            
- `idMember`: id of the member assessed.
- `idProtocol`: a Bioimpedance protocol (`type` 2) from `GET /api/v2/fitness-assessment/protocol/{idBranch}`.
  Measurements of fields not enabled in the protocol are discarded (see `protocol-detail`).
- `idEmployee`: employee responsible for the assessment. When omitted, the employee linked to the API key is used.
- The expiry date is the creation date plus the fitness assessment validity configured in the branch, in days
  (1 day when the branch has no validity configured). It can be changed later with the `PUT`.
            
**`basicData`** is required, with every field filled. The 400 response lists the missing fields.
- `weight`: weight in kg, greater than zero.
- `height`: height in cm (e.g. `175`), greater than zero.
- `birthDate`: required, but the assessment always stores the birth date of the member's registration in EVO.
- `age`: age in years at the time of the assessment.
- `biologicalSex`: `M` (male) or `F` (female).
- `morphology`: `ectomorfo` (ectomorph), `mesomorfo` (mesomorph) or `endomorfo` (endomorph).
- `objectives`: at least one objective code, e.g. `emagrecer` (weight loss), `saude` (health), `hipertrofia` (hypertrophy),
  `condicionamento` (conditioning), `conhecer_pessoas` (meet people). The gym may have other codes.
- `objectivesDescription`: read only, ignored on input.
            
**Measurements** are optional and are kept only for the fields enabled in the protocol.
- `muscleMass`, `fatMass`, `fatFreeMass`, `skeletalMass`, `residuals`: kg.
- `bodyFatPercentage`, `visceralFatPercentage`: %.
- `basalMetabolicRate`: kcal. `metabolicAge`: years. `waistHipRatio`: waist-to-hip ratio. `obesityDegree`: obesity degree.
- `bodyWater`: liters when the protocol has `bodyWaterLitersEnabled`, percentage when it has `bodyWaterPercentageEnabled`.
- Segmental analysis, in kg: `muscleMass...` and `fatMass...` for `RightArm`, `LeftArm`, `RightLeg`, `LeftLeg` and `Trunk`
  (e.g. `muscleMassRightArm`, `fatMassTrunk`).
            
**Photos** (`photoFront`, `photoBack`, `photoLeftSide`, `photoRightSide`) must be public `https` URLs pointing directly
to a JPEG or PNG image of up to 5 MB (redirects are not followed; download time limit of 5 seconds). EVO downloads and
stores the images. A value that is not an `https` URL, or an image that cannot be downloaded, is ignored without error
and the photo is left empty.
            
To read the created assessment, use `GET /api/v2/fitness-assessment?idMember={idMember}&idFitnessAssessment={id}&idType=2`.

200.description: Assessment created. Body: `{ "idFitnessAssessment": 123 }`, the id of the new assessment.

400.description: Invalid body — `{ "error": "message" }`, e.g. `basicData` incomplete — or member/protocol not found — `{ "errors": [ { "key": "Avaliacao", "value": "message" } ] }` (each item has at least `key` and `value`).

put.description:
Replaces the data of a bioimpedance assessment of the branch of the key. Send the complete assessment, as in the
`POST`: measurements and photos left out of the body are cleared.
            
- `idMember` and `idProtocol` are validated but do not move the assessment to another member or protocol.
  Send the values of the assessment: the protocol defines which measurements are kept.
- `basicData` follows the same rules of the `POST`.
- `idEmployee` is not used in the update: the employee who performed the assessment is kept.
- `expiryDate` is optional: when omitted, the current expiry date is kept.
- New photos follow the same rules of the `POST`. To keep a photo, send back the URL returned by
  `GET /api/v2/fitness-assessment`: URLs of EVO storage are kept as they are.

parameters.name: idFitnessAssessment
parameters.description: Id of the bioimpedance assessment, as returned by the `POST`.

400.description: Invalid body — `{ "error": "message" }` — or assessment, member or protocol not found — `{ "errors": [ { "key": "Avaliacao", "value": "message" } ] }` (each item has at least `key` and `value`; a missing assessment is reported with the "protocol not found" message).

delete.description:
Deletes a bioimpedance assessment of the branch of the key, the same way as the EVO APP: the record is kept,
flagged as deleted with the employee and the date of the deletion, and is no longer returned by the queries.
Only bioimpedance assessments can be deleted through the API.

parameters.name: idFitnessAssessment
parameters.description: Id of the bioimpedance assessment, as returned by the `POST`.

parameters.name: idEmployee
parameters.description: Employee recorded as responsible for the deletion. When omitted, the employee linked to the API key is used.

400.description: Assessment not found in the branch of the key. Body: `{ "errors": [ { "key": "Avaliacao", "value": "message" } ] }` (reported with the "protocol not found" message).

get.description:
**membershipType** represents the membership modality configured on EVO (Administrativo > Contratos)
and is localized by the request culture. Possible values (en-US): Common contract, Plan extension,
Locking extension, Monthly recurrence, Recurring debit c term, Automatic renewal, Additional dependent,
Contract for a given purpose, Add-on membership, Recurring Pix and Automatic Pix. It never indicates
whether an add-on link is fixed or optional — that is the additionalType of each link.
            
**additionalMemberships** (returned when showAdditionalMemberships=true): add-on memberships linked to
the main membership. Each item contains idMembership, nameMembership, membershipType (always the
Add-on membership modality), value (configured value), inactive, additionalType
and defaultSaleValue. The link belongs to the PAIR main+add-on: the same add-on may be Fixed for one
main membership and Optional for another.
            
**additionalType**: Fixed = mandatory, included automatically when the main membership is sold, never
sold alone. Optional = chosen by the integration, sold together with the main membership or alone when
the member already has an eligible main membership.
            
**defaultSaleValue**: the value used by Sales/Carts when membershipValue is not informed. When the main
membership has "Apply value proportional to duration" enabled (additionalValueProportionalToDuration =
true), it is the configured value multiplied by the months of the main membership duration (a 1-month
duration does not change the value); otherwise it equals the configured value. When the integration
informs membershipValue on the sale, that value is final and is not multiplied again.

post.description:
**additionalMemberships** (optional array): optional add-on memberships sold in the same operation.
Each item is an object with idMembership and an optional membershipValue — object structure, never
parallel arrays. Only add-ons previously linked as OPTIONAL to the main membership can be informed;
FIXED add-ons must not be sent — they are always included automatically with the main membership.
When membershipValue is omitted, EVO uses the default sale value of the link (configured value,
multiplied by the main membership duration when the proportionality rule is enabled — see
defaultSaleValue on GET v3/membership). When informed, the value is FINAL for that add-on and is not
multiplied again. Omitting the array (or sending it empty) sells only the main membership and its FIXED
add-ons — optional add-ons are never sold unless informed here.
            
Main membership with one optional add-on (default value):
            
    { "idBranch": 1, "idMembership": 100, "memberData": { "idMember": 123 }, "payment": 14,
      "additionalMemberships": [ { "idMembership": 200 } ] }
            
Main membership with multiple optional add-ons (value override on the second one):
            
    { "idBranch": 1, "idMembership": 100, "memberData": { "idMember": 123 }, "payment": 14,
      "additionalMemberships": [ { "idMembership": 200 }, { "idMembership": 201, "membershipValue": 45.00 } ] }
            
Only add-ons for an existing member — idMembership identifies the FIRST add-on and the array carries
the others; each add-on is linked to an eligible main membership already owned by the member:
            
    { "idBranch": 1, "idMembership": 200, "membershipValue": 45.00, "memberData": { "idMember": 123 },
      "payment": 14, "additionalMemberships": [ { "idMembership": 201, "membershipValue": 30.00 } ] }
            
Eligibility of the add-on only sale: same member, allowed branch, main membership active or with an
eligible future start, linked as Optional to the add-on and within its term dates. When different
add-ons are eligible for different main memberships, each one is linked to its own. Not available for
prospects. If ANY add-on of the operation is invalid, the WHOLE sale is rejected — nothing is created.
            
Main rejection reasons (HTTP 400, errors with key "AdditionalMemberships" identifying the idMembership
and the reason): add-on not found; not an add-on membership; inactive;
not linked to the main membership as Optional; fixed add-on informed; duplicated add-on; same
membership informed as main and add-on; invalid (negative) membershipValue; member has no eligible main
membership; add-on only sale for prospect; start date outside the main membership term.
